thread:
mia: starting a config-only rollout in ~10m. target change: tighten tiny-burst limits, reduce request timeout to 8s, bump default routing weight to stable for latency protection. will do 1% canary -> 25% -> 100% if healthy.

mia: config snippet i'm pushing (for visibility):
```yaml
routing:
  default_weight: 0.97
  region_overrides:
    apac: 0.75
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 400
  window_ms: 12
limits:
  qps_per_tenant: 6
timeouts:
  request: 8s
  kvcache_warmup: 25s
```

deploy-bot: scheduled config-only deploy `cfg-rollout/6912345678` to env=prod in 10 minutes. canary=1%, ramp=[1,25,100] at [10m, 30m, 2h] unless manually held. to abort: `deploy-bot abort 6912345678`

lila-ops: ready. i'll be on watch for the first 45 minutes. if APAC p99 spikes > 400ms or error-rate > 0.5%, i'll flip region_override or trigger rollback.
